about: Where each of Angelo's agents may write, from its ABP (content/abp/<agent>-web-summit-angelo.md, Mandate, Deployment scope) and Angelo's protocol (people/angelo/kit/README.md#protocol). Kept by policy@web-summit.angelo; read by people/angelo/policy/audit.mjs. A write outside these paths is not always a violation (tier 2 allows small changes the owner asked for, said so in the commit), but every one is listed and judged in findings.md.
enforce_about: Turned on by policy@PrompTugal.angelo on 8 November 2026 at 07:30 UTC: since the check went in (42198055, 7 November 22:17), every outside write by Angelo's agents was declared (5 of 5) and none was refused; the one earlier refusal (d89d2576) predates the check. From now on release.sh and CI refuse an undeclared write outside a lane.

everyone.two_files_rule: a new page and the first link to it, inside people/angelo/, in one commit (the protocol); listed, not a finding

others_files: From 6 November (Angelo, ce069603) an agent may change another owner's file directly, under the tiers, with five steps: fresh dev, look at the last two hours and picked issues, For: <owner> in the commit, never overwrite on a rebase conflict, shared data one entry at a time. audit.mjs lists such writes and flags one without a For: line other than Angelo's own agents.
common_why: reports/ (each agent's report file for the desk) and proposals/ (drafts of anything, tier 1, and the protocol's place for drafts and specs) are every agent's, by practice and the protocol
reserved_about: policy@'s folder holds the lanes and the check the gate runs, so an audited agent must not change them: refused to any other agent, declared or not (policy@, 8 November). A change to them is sent to policy@ in a commit.
